nom: TULA 24-7 Ultra Hydration Triple-Hydra Complex Day & Night Serum

avis.titre: Love the product Hate the packaging
avis.texte: I am going to return because I cannot get any serum out. I keep pumping it and almost nothing comes out. It worked the first time but now it's not pumping any serum. I did love the serum itself, but not sure I'll buy it again.
I received a sample of this and loved it. I've been using it for about a month now and my skin is so much happier. Softer, smoother and more plump!

avis.titre: I BUY this product over and over!!!
avis.texte: I have atopic dermatitis and this is the only line of skin care that works for my face!!! It doesn't irritate, burn or break me out!!!
I rarely find a skin care item that I love and know I will repurchase and this is one of them!! Makes my skin soft and hydrated—gives you an amazing glow from within.
Since this serum is water-based, it works very well to hydrate my clients' skin and prepare their skin before applying makeup. Their skin always looks perfect.

This is literally the only serum I've tried that makes a VISIBLE difference in my skin. Everything is starting to even out tone/texture wise and I will absolutely be repurchasing the second I run out!!
Great for my nighttime slumber! Hydration while sleeping, lovely!

I have been using Tula products for about 3 years now and all have been wonderful! HOWEVER, this product has been the best ever and exceeded my expectations. I will be 77 in June and have minimal wrinkles for my age except around my eyes ( use Tula wrinkle drops bakuchiol serum in that area). Now the 24-7 Ultra Hydration has resulted in a glow in my face that I never thought possible at my age!! I continue to be surprised every time I use it, I highly recommend this product…and hope others experience the same amazing results. Babs, Portland, Oregon.

I bought this because after a facial I was told my skin is super dry. I've reordered this 4 times now! It helps my skin feel more hydrated and I can tell the difference if I'm in a hurry and skip this step of my skin care routine. I would definitely recommend this product!
This serum absorbs quickly leaving a radiant glow and bounce to my skin.

After the Cult Classic this is my favorite Tula product... Or wait.... I adore the gold glow up.... And the secret solution...or h2oasis!! I can't decide my favorite! Guess I just review 1 item at at a time without spilling out all my choices!

I received this product from my Ipsy box and I love it so much I had to get more! I wasn't sure about it at first because my skin can be ify at times but it was love at first pump. I can literally see my face get plump and bouncy. It also sits very nicely under makeup and layers well with other skin products. Just perfect
Paired it with the moisturizer together day and night I love the products now I use Tula all the time daily

I've been looking for a serum that my sensitive skin doesn't react to. This exceeded my expectations!! My skin drinks this serum up and has never looked so hydrated. I love how light weight it is and how well it absorbs into my skin. It pairs nicely with both the hydrating day and night cream and the ultra hydrating day and night cream. New staple for sure!!
Really love this triple hyaluronic serum… I'm in my fourth purchase.
Love but feel as you need more than other products for the full effect

I did not notice it did anything for me but why I gave it a 1 star is because when I thought the bottle was empty, I pulled the tops off and found another good plus tablespoon in the container that I should have been able to pump out! Not sure if anyone else does this with products but nobody has an odd pump like this one. And no the pump worked fine it was not that. People are paying a lot of money for these products. Get a better bottle so all the product comes out!

avis.titre: I would not waste my time
avis.texte: I had high hopes for this stuff. It goes on like water. It does not hydrate at all. And yes, I use it with other Tula products that I am equally as disappointed in. Especially considering the price.
This product is terrific. It goes on like silk on your skin. It hydrates all day under makeup. I have ordered it more than once. Love it!
I use this after washing my face then apply the moisturizer and it always makes my face feel nice and hydrated but not greasy or too wet!

avis.titre: must try if you have dry, textured skin
avis.texte: I got a free trial size of this product and tried it on a whim— I am so freaking glad I did because this stuff is amazing. It made my dry skin hydrated and sooooo smooth. I will def be buying a full size. My skin needs this
The pump stopped pumping after using for like 2 weeks. Now no product was coming out the pump. Such a waste

I thought this product was just okay. It didnt do much for my skin personally. Plus it ran out pretty quickly compared to most serums i have tried. It seemed very similar texture wise to elf holy hydration triple bounce serum. So if you like that texture give this a try.

Can't live without! I have used 3 of these and always return. Perfect after applying toner to let the extra moisture sink in. It's light and absorbs instantly and has made a difference in the softness of my skin. Great pairing with the moisturizer.

avis.titre: The BEST hydration for sensitive rosacea/acne prone skin!!
avis.texte: After dozens of acne and rosacea flare ups using many, many other products, this is the ONLY ONE which consistently hydrates my skin without aggravating it. No scent, nothing harsh about it. It hydrates and keeps my skin silky soft without causing redness or breakouts. The best product Tula makes, hands down!

Mid 30's combo skin. Use this after toner. It feels good and I don't experience any pilling. Layer serum and moisturizer on top and everything soaks in well. Was a good price on sale, pretty pricey at full price. I think there are plenty of other more affordable options.

I use First Aid beauty cream but it seems like lately it just wasn't doing the trick, especially under my eyes. I applied this toner, then my beauty cream and immediately saw a difference. I'm 55 this year and this really helps my under eye area not to look as crepey when I apply my concealer. My skin also feels so soft hours later than with my beauty cream alone. I bought it on sale during Days of Beauty, I think, and I'll watch for it to come on sale again so I can get another bottle for when I run out of this one.
Love the way this serum makes my skin look and feel! Very hydrating! Would highly recommend this product!

This is the first time ordering this product. It's not bad but I probably wouldn't order again. The texture is nice and it's hydrating as advertised but pills. I am reserving this for night time use to avoid this issue.
I l❤️ve this product. It tops off my moisturizer giving my face a glass skin look with a super soft and hydrated feel.
I've tried this serum before and I have not had any complaints. I suffer from Rosacea and I cannot use just any products. I recommend this product if you have sensible skin.
Could see plumper skin especially around u ND my eyes pretty instantly. Def took hyaluronic acid to a new level.
This serum keeps your face moisturized & soft. Tula products are excellent has made a difference on my skin. HAPPY

avis.titre: Too expensive for how much you get
avis.texte: I love this stuff but wont be buying again. It is pretty amazing but one pump isnt nearly enough imo and I run out so fast! It would have to be half the price for me to find it worth it.

I was pushed to buy this cleaner brand by tula in store over my usual la roche posay what i usually get & was told it was oil free. My dermatologist advises me to use only oil free & non-comedogenic products. I asked ulta online if it was oil free it is not only non- comedogenic. So it is a big no no for me these kind of products will make me get cysts on my face.

I LOVE Tula products and had found my holy grail routine for my sensitive skin but they he Vitamin B Serum was discontinued and so they recommended this product. It's good but it leaves my skin much more greasy and less plump and dewy than the vitamin b serum did. I also felt the vitamin b serum helped more with redness and evening out my skin tone and coloration. Overall, this product is okay, but nothing compared to the vitamin b serum for my personal skin.
This cream looks and feels so soft and has certainly balanced my face quite well. Such a great base before applying my other TULA products .
So far so good been using just over a week all ready see a big difference worth the money
This is my go to serum it is light and not sticky and there is no smell my skin feels hydrated and sometimes I use it instead of primer
I love how hydrating this is! I have a tendency towards dry skin so this has been amazingly helpful.

avis.titre: My go-to serum for day and night!
avis.texte: This has been a game changer in my routine! I use one pump day and night before moisturizer and this feels so good on my sensitive skin. I swear this single product has made my skin more hydrated and balanced overall, and has avtually helped to clear up my hormonal acne. My biggest beef with this product is that even with 2 total pumps per day, you run out fast. I have repurchased 6-7 times already, maybe more! To me it's worth it but I wish it was more product for the price. The dispenser has broken/refused to pump at least 2 of the times I have purchased but I was able to tinker with the bottle and figure out how to fix it but kind of annoying given the cost. Regardless, the product itself is a must-have step in my daily routine!

I like this product. But if you use it as much as it recommends you will go through it very fast, and it's expensive. So, doesn't its job? Absolutely and it is very moisturizing, but is it worth the money as a must have in your routine? I'm not sure.
The best serum around. Goes on smoothly and I love the smell. Plumps the skin instantly.
Using this day/night serum has made a tremendous impact on my skin. I wake up with skin still in glow and hydrated. My skin is definitely more supple. I love this product!
Super hydrating & makes my skin feel amazing! I pair it with the 24 hour day+night moisturizer as well! I have combo skin, but my cheeks get super dry. I love this stuff!!

I have sensitive skin and the morning after using it my skin felt itchy. I still have to use it again and see if I get the same results. Overall it felt nice applying, cool without a sticky sensation.

I was recommended this as a good serum since they didn't have the one I use in store. It's fine, not nearly as hydrating as I need. It also goes very fast. I've been using it for about two weeks-ish and I'm almost halfway through the bottle.

I love this serum! I have very sensitive skin and many products that I have tried leave my skin looking irritated and feeling dry and itchy. This is a very light weight serum. You only have to use a small amount. I apply it in the evening and in the morning, my skin looks refreshed and feels really soft.

avis.titre: great product but you go through it. quickly
avis.texte: I really like this product. It made me skin silky smooth. The consistency was very thin, almost water like and I went through it extremely quickly. The quantity/quality of the product vs the cost of the product isn't worth it.
This is a fabulous multi-tasker. I find that application in the PM only is enough to be effective. My skin feels smooth, hydrated and looks great when I wake up. The pump dispenser is truly unique!
I love putting this on at night. It feels slightly sticky at first but when I wake up in the morning my skin is GLOWING.
Triple Hydrate! It really feels good on my face, meaning it is light and not heavy.
My face feels really smooth when i use this product, and my face looks hydrated.

avis.titre: If I could give 0 stars I would
avis.texte: My skin is so inflamed and red and dry from using this product. I do NOT have sensitive skin at all and have never had any skin allergies or issues, however after using this product only 1 or 2 times, it left me so awfully uncomfortable. DO NOT BUY!!!!
I got this as a hydration booster because I was noticing my cheek bones were drying out this winter. Definitely recommend, noticed this working the first couple times I used it! Even pregnancy safe!

I don't know why but Tula products always break me out and this is no different. It felt great on my skin, but after two days the pores on my forehead and chin were clogged. My face also felt greasy. I'm giving up on this brand.
This applies smoothly and doesn't leave a sticky reside. I love how lightweight it is
This has made such a big difference in my skin! Not only does it feel more hydrated, but it also helped clear my skin too! I won't go a day without it!

avis.titre: One of the best serums I'
avis.texte: One of the best serums I've used. Not greasy. Absorbs nicely.

avis.titre: Nice and light, I mix it
avis.texte: Nice and light, I mix it in with my primer or other tinted facial treatments.
It is a gorgeous product that I got to use for one day but the cap is faulty and now I can't get any more product out but I am sure I'll be able to sort it out with CS, in my experience they are a 10

2024!! New 24/7 serum! Wahooo!! so, this serum . is by far , my favorite Tula product! It's my liquid gold' But, this particular bottle , This time around .. I was a little disappointed in:( this bottle it didn't pump out as it usually does. I love the slide top to open the spout. Nice and easy. No mess. but. This bottle ….the texture was different more watery. The bubbles weren't as tiny like the other bottles I've used . It's as if like there was more air in the bottle? I reached out, of course , and the representative helped me and gave me a great tip, to flip it, upside down and tap it a few times. It worked! But, I still have to do this each time which is a bummer. And I definitely notice a difference in the texture, how it absorbs, but, what can you do?
Of all the really amazing things I got, this is my absolute favorite. I have super dry AND oily skin and this balances my skin out so well and it's never been this moisturized probably ever...
I love the Triple-Hydra!! My face feels so thirsty when I put this on.

Originally got this as a sample from Ipsy and had to buy the big size. It's so nourishing/moisturizing and lightweight. It leaves my skin looking well balanced and gives it a healthy glow. Love the bottle it comes in as there is none to be wasted since it pumps from the bottom.

I love this product. I have such dry and flaky skin from having eczema on my face, but once I treat a flare up, this product keeps my skin so hydrated. A little pricey but honestly so worth it for the results.

I love this product. I have such dry and flaky skin from having eczema on my face, but once I treat a flare up, this product keeps my skin so hydrated. A little pricey but honestly so worth it for the results.

avis.titre: Works Great but bottle design has flaws
avis.texte: I love the product itself; however, once I got closer to the last part of the bottle, there is still product in the container but the pump will no longer allow any out once it reached a certain point. Disappointed about the fact these products cost quite a bit to not be able to finish the bottle and get the most out of the money spent.
I like the way it leaves my face feeling moist however if I get it too close to my eyes it burns very badly. Therefore I may not be reordering
I just finished my first bottle and will be purchasing a second. My skin feels so good and hydrated after adding this to my routine
I am so pleased with this product! It keeps my skin hydrated, plump, and firm all day. My skin glows from the moment I apply it. I see definite improvement in the condition of my skin!
This product is super hydrating! It looks super cute on my counter as well. My face feels soft and plush. I
Feels so cool when applied, instant relief. I use it daily and can tell the results already.

I've been using this at night with another product. It's hard to say if the difference I see is from one, or both. I'll continue to use it as I am seeing a difference in the overall quality of my skin
I really love this product! It's so hydrating. I have only been using it for a couple of weeks but love it so far!
This is one of my favorites as it's so hydrating and one of the best serums I've ever used.
I really love this serum, it leaves my skin feeling so good. I love everything from Tula!!
Love this product! Glides on in a weightless cover. Feels light and makes my skin feel hydrated.
Feels great on the skin, super light weight and moisturizing. Gives a dewy look to the skin. Highly recommend
I loved this serum ever since it came out. but lately I've noticed now with the hot weather , I started breaking out really bad if I wear it while in the sun. Not sure why....

My skin is so dry and flaky. After just one use it's gone. My skin is plump and hydrated. I also bought the hydrating cream which I don't even really need because the serum works great by itself. So I just use the cream at night. Highly recommend.

The Tula team was amazing and helped me with my questions. I have been using Tula for the last two years. I love this skincare brand so much! I am giving the triple-hydra complex day & night serum to my mother for her birthday. I can't wait to give it to her.

This serum immediately hydrates my skin and leaves me glowing. I am a breastfeeding mama and I have been struggling with dehydrated skin, especially on my face. This serum, added to my routine, has finally made my face hydrated again.
Have been using this for about a week now and love it. Use it morning and night and my skin feels super hydrated, not as parched as it was working from home in our dry apartment. So far so good!
My face feels so plump and hydrated! I will be recommending!!!!

I love the actual product. However, about halfway through the bottle, the pump became defective, as in I'm pushing the pump down and no product is coming out. I reached out to customer service and they weren't really that helpful, just telling me to turn it upside down and tap on the bottom. Still having the same issue and there's so much product left unused.

Love this serum so much! Actually works and definitely something I will be using from here on out. Deeply hydrates my skin therefore keeping my oils in check and breakouts away. In my late twenties I am also wanting to take care of my skin now to help it age in a healthy way, and I think this is really going to help. I have noticed the one really deep wrinkle on my forehead is less noticeable since starting to use this day and night over a month ago! Just wish there was a bit more product for the price. All of the air bubbles inside the product can make it a bit deceiving! 4.5 out of 5 stars!

avis.titre: Feels like my face is firming!
avis.texte: After a few days of adding this to my routine, I've felt so much more plump/firmness in the areas I felt were wrinkly/tired looking. Love the feeling of it!

Feels so luxurious and hydrating without leaving my face feeling sticky or tacky the way some hyaluronic acid serums can do. I wish it came in a larger size! I also love the new design of the pump! I wish Tula would upgrade all their serums to this type of bottle and top.
I have been using my first Tula product For one week now. I notice my skin is Firmer & more supple. Also, the appearance of fine lines has diminished slightly.
Amazing hydration for your skin! A little bit goes a long way! Makes your skin look plump which is perfect for summer

This product is very hydrating and works well with using just one pump. I am able to use little product and spread it on my face and neck. I look and feel refreshed and I stay hydrated all night/day long. It's not greasy at all. I like to use this with another moisturizer and a serum at night.
New fave serum! You need the smallest amount & it feels light & airy! Def adding it to the rotation!!

My face felt so much better after the first use! My face has been super dry and I needed something hydrating and this was exactly it! It also weight free very light don't even know it's on your face! But your face will feel super soft after using it! I do it in the am and pm like it says! Love it!!
I love this product! It's so hydrating! I use it morning and evening. It's super lightweight. My skin looks so glowing after I apply!
I use this morning and night. Feels like silk going on. Lightweight yet effective. This is a must in my daily routine!
